Looking at the tools available, I don't have a direct "show reviews" or "show questions" tool. However, the task asks me to answer based on Amazon reviews or questions/answers. Let me check if there's any way to access this information through the available tools.

Unfortunately, the available Amazon tools don't include a function to retrieve product reviews or questions/answers. I can see the product has 5 reviews and 4 questions, but I cannot access their content with the tools provided.

Let me check if there's any other way to find this information.

I don't have a tool to read Amazon product reviews or questions/answers. None of these tools allow me to read product reviews or questions/answers. I cannot retrieve the battery life information from verified purchasers' reviews or Q&A as requested.

I apologize, but I'm unable to answer this question with the tools available to me. The Amazon API tools I have access to do not include a function to read product reviews or questions/answers.
